snippet.title: Animal Life: Dinosaurs Longplay [NDS] [No-Com]
snippet.description:
Educational game about animals living in Past
Minigames aren't necessary but you have to do all animals' minigames on Perfect to beat the game
Have Fun :D

00:00 Beginning
00:14 Tyrannosaurus Rex
03:15 Apatosaurus
05:28 Animal Race
06:40 Triceratops
09:26 Maths
09:55 Stegosaurus
12:15 Munch 
13:19 Velociraptor
16:16 Ending + Credits
